name: SHIP-READY Run 2 — G3 grabber AS SHIPPED (declared == shipped)
_doc: PURPOSE: this set declares what Run 2 actually SHIPPED, so it must exit 0.
It is the counterpart to shipready-grabber-stacks.json, which is the ARBITRATION
record and exits 1 BY DESIGN because it deliberately declares the failing
borderStrong rows. That file is evidence and is NOT edited to go green — deleting
the failing rows would erase the reason the decision was made.
RUN: node ~/AccessMap-material-lab/2026-07-02/shared/contrast-check.mjs design-reviews/ship-ready/tools/shipready-grabber-shipped-stacks.json
WHAT SHIPPED (Sky, §SKY-6): the grabber on all three pageSheets, ink =
color.inkGlassMuted, placement ABOVE the header including on Nearby.
- Resources + HowToHelp: inside the absolute chrome pane -> 'chrome'
- Nearby: above styles.header, on the bulk fill -> 'bulkSheet'
- Tasks filter sheet: ui/Sheet's shared pill, same ink -> 'bulkSheet' (the SEAM)
Both transparency states are declared because the user can flip Reduce
Transparency at any time; both must clear the 3.0 floor.
ALSO CARRIED HERE: the Car 1 terms-link ink (color.brandOnSoft on the bulk report
sheet). It is a byte-identical reuse of the treatment AboutScreen already ships
on the same material, but 'already shipped elsewhere' is an argument, not a
measurement, so it is measured. Text ink at 4.5 (it is body text, not chrome).
SELF-CHECK: the last row reproduces the shipped close-X, a known-good pairing.
FINDING, 2026-07-28: this row was FIRST declared as color.brand, byte-identical to the
link AboutScreen already shipped on this material — and it FAILED at 3.70:1 light /
3.56:1 dark against the 4.5 body-text floor. The shipped privacy link had the same
defect and had never been measured. Both moved to brandOnSoft. This is the arbiter
catching a real AA failure in code that had already passed every other gate.
If it ever fails, the manifest is broken rather than the app.
GATE: exit 0 is required at every Run-2 commit.
